title: Samsung Galaxy S24 Unlocked Android Smartphone, 128GB, Onyx Black — AI Photo Assist, 6.2" Dynamic AMOLED
bullets: Google Tensor G3 delivers on-device AI for Magic Eraser, Call Screen, and Live Translate without sending your data to the cloud.
6.7" LTPO OLED display at up to 120 Hz with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 for smooth scrolling and outdoor brightness.
Triple rear camera system: 50 MP wide, 48 MP ultrawide (macro), and 48 MP telephoto with 5x optical zoom.
description: Pixel 8 Pro is Google's flagship unlocked smartphone built around the Tensor G3 chip and a pro-grade camera system. The 6.7-inch LTPO OLED panel adapts refresh rate from 1–120 Hz to balance smoothness and battery life.

reviews.author: Alex R.
reviews.title: Best camera phone I have owned
reviews.body: Night Sight and the telephoto zoom are excellent. Battery easily lasts a full workday with 5G on. Unlocked activation on T-Mobile took under ten minutes.

reviews.author: Priya K.
reviews.title: Great phone, warm under load
reviews.body: Display and speakers are first-class. It can get warm during 4K video, but nothing alarming. Happy I skipped carrier bloatware by buying unlocked.
